ISE.intake: 180 (UG B.E.), 18 (PG M.Tech. in AI & Data Science)
ISE.about: Established in 2000, the Department of Information Science and Engineering initially offered a B.E. Degree program with an annual intake of 40 students. Over the years, this intake grew to 60 in 2018 and further expanded to 180 by 2024. Additionally, in 2023, an M.Tech program in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science was introduced with an annual intake of 18 students. The department boasts experienced faculty who actively participate in workshops and training programs to stay updated with emerging technologies. Equipped with Computer Centers that cater to program requirements, the department also provides Internet and Wi-Fi access. Its in-house library contains over 1,369 volumes. As part of the ISE Association (ISEA), the department conducts regular technical lectures and personality development programs. The department maintains a strong placement record with reputable organizations, and its alumni pursue higher studies both nationally and internationally. Bi-annually, the department publishes the 'ISEAN' newsletter featuring technical and non-technical contributions from students and faculty.
ISE.vision: The department will be a premier centre focusing on knowledge dissemination and generation to address the emerging needs of information technology in diverse fields.
ISE.mission:
1. To make students competent to contribute towards the development of IT field.
2. Promote learning and practice of latest tools and technologies among students and prepare them for diverse career options.
3. Collaborate with industry and institutes of higher learning for Research and Development, innovations and continuing education.
4. Developing capacity of teachers in terms of their teaching and research abilities.
5. Develop software applications to solve engineering and societal problems.
ISE.programs_offered:
- B.E. in Information Science and Engineering (Intake: 180)
- M.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science (Intake: 18)
ISE.labs_facilities: Computer Centers with LAN and Wi-Fi connectivity, in-house Department Library with 1369+ volumes, ISEA Student Association, Research Center under VTU.
ISE.achievements: Consistent high university academic results, strong placement records with leading multinational IT companies, active student publications in 'ISEAN' newsletter.
ISE.labs_and_facilities: Computer Centers with LAN and Wi-Fi connectivity, in-house Department Library with 1369+ volumes, ISEA Student Association, Research Center under VTU.

CSE.intake: 420 (UG B.E.), 12 (PG M.Tech. in AI and Data Science)
CSE.about: The Department of Computer Science & Engineering was established in the year 1983-84. It offers a four-year B.E. course with an intake of 420 students. The department also offers an M.Tech course in AI and Data Science with an intake of 12 students from the academic year 2025-26. VTU has recognized the department as a research center for carrying out research work leading to M.Sc. (Engg) by Research and Ph.D. degrees. The department is accredited by NBA. The department has highly qualified faculty and well-equipped labs that serve the curriculum requirements and facilitate innovative projects meeting fast-changing societal needs. The department maintains a good rapport with the IT industry, with collaborations through MOUs. Seminars and workshops are organized regularly. Alumni of CSE function across the globe in leadership roles, and the department has an outstanding placement track record.
CSE.vision: To become a prominent department of Computer Science & Engineering producing competent professionals with research and innovation skills, inculcating moral values and societal concerns.
CSE.mission:
1. Impart world class engineering education to produce technically competent engineers.
2. Provide facilities and expertise in advanced computer technology to promote research.
3. Enhance Industry readiness and entrepreneurial abilities through innovative skills.
4. Nurture ethical values and social responsibilities.
CSE.programs_offered:
- B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering (Intake: 420)
- M.Tech. in AI and Data Science (Intake: 12)
- M.Sc. (Engg) by Research and Ph.D. under VTU Research Center
CSE.labs_facilities: High-performance computing laboratories, advanced networking and software engineering labs, industry-partnered research facilities, dedicated department library.
CSE.achievements: NBA Accredited, recognized VTU Research Center, active MOUs with top IT corporations, stellar campus placement conversion.
CSE.labs_and_facilities: High-performance computing laboratories, advanced networking and software engineering labs, industry-partnered research facilities, dedicated department library.

AIML.about: The Department of Computer Science & Engineering (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning) offers an autonomous B.E. program with an intake of 60 students. The program focuses on state-of-the-art computational algorithms, deep learning, computer vision, natural language processing, data analytics, and intelligent systems. The curriculum is designed in alignment with modern industry standards to prepare students for core technical roles in artificial intelligence, machine learning engineering, and data science research. Students benefit from specialized AI hardware, GPU clusters, and hands-on project-based learning.
AIML.vision: To be a center of excellence in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning education, nurturing innovative engineers capable of solving complex societal and industrial problems through intelligent technologies.
AIML.mission:
1. Deliver rigorous education in foundational and applied Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.
2. Facilitate cutting-edge laboratory infrastructure and hands-on project exposure in deep learning and data engineering.
3. Foster multidisciplinary research, industry collaborations, and entrepreneurial initiatives in intelligent systems.
4. Inculcate professional ethics, data privacy principles, and social responsibility.
AIML.programs_offered: - B.E. in Computer Science & Engineering (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning) (Intake: 60)
AIML.labs_facilities: AI and Deep Learning Laboratory, High-Performance GPU Computing Facility, Data Science and Analytics Lab, Cloud Computing Lab.
AIML.achievements: Active student participation in national hackathons and AI competitions, high-demand recruitment by AI and analytics firms, specialized workshops in Generative AI and Machine Learning.
AIML.labs_and_facilities: AI and Deep Learning Laboratory, High-Performance GPU Computing Facility, Data Science and Analytics Lab, Cloud Computing Lab.

CSBS.about: The Department of Computer Science and Business Systems (CSBS) offers an autonomous B.E. program with an annual intake of 60 students. Designed to address the growing demand for engineering graduates proficient in both computing technology and modern business management, the CSBS curriculum combines core computer science (algorithms, software engineering, databases, cloud computing) with contemporary business disciplines (financial analytics, business strategy, marketing, design thinking, and business communication). The program prepares students for leadership and technical roles in digital enterprises.
CSBS.vision: To produce industry-ready engineering professionals who seamlessly integrate computer science expertise with strategic business insight to drive innovation in digital enterprises.
CSBS.mission:
1. Provide a balanced curriculum integrating core computer science principles with modern business administration concepts.
2. Offer practical exposure through corporate case studies, enterprise software laboratories, and industry internships.
3. Cultivate leadership, financial acumen, strategic thinking, and effective communication skills.
4. Promote ethical conduct and sustainable technological solutions in global business environments.
CSBS.programs_offered: - B.E. in Computer Science and Business Systems (Intake: 60)
CSBS.labs_facilities: Enterprise Systems and Software Engineering Lab, Business Analytics and Data Mining Lab, Modern Computing Center with high-speed internet.
CSBS.achievements: Strong corporate placements in enterprise consulting, IT management, fintech, and digital transformation services.
CSBS.labs_and_facilities: Enterprise Systems and Software Engineering Lab, Business Analytics and Data Mining Lab, Modern Computing Center with high-speed internet.

CIVIL.about: The Civil Engineering Department (CED) is one of the reputed foundational departments in MCE Hassan, established in 1960. It is recognized as a Research Centre under Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), Belagavi, and as a Minor Quality Improvement Program (QIP) Centre. CED offers a UG Program - B.E. in Civil Engineering with an intake of 120 students and a PG Program - M.Tech. in Computer Aided Design of Structures (CADS) with an intake of 18 students. The teaching faculty members have an average experience of 10 years, including 6 Ph.D.s, 7 ongoing Ph.D.s, and 12 Post Graduates. The department has an in-house library exclusively for UG/PG students and 24x7 Wi-Fi. The department regularly organizes the Dr. C. Gifferd Satyadas Memorial Lecture Series, student-alumni interactions, and coordinates the active ASCE Student Chapter and the SustaiNest student club (formed 01.12.2023).
CIVIL.vision: To establish excellence in Civil Engineering education through sustainable design and execution, ethical innovation and applied research.
CIVIL.mission:
1. To impart education to design durable, resource-efficient structures using optimization design and lifecycle analysis to minimize environmental impact while maximizing service life.
2. To translate academic research into field-validated solutions through consultancy, training, structured testing programs and Institute-industry partnerships.
3. To maintain uncompromising commitment to professional codes, public safety, and ethical practices in all design, innovation, and construction activities.
CIVIL.programs_offered:
- B.E. in Civil Engineering (Intake: 120)
- M.Tech. in Computer Aided Design of Structures (CADS) (Intake: 18)
- Ph.D. and M.Sc. (Engg) by Research under VTU
CIVIL.labs_facilities: Structural Engineering Lab, Geotechnical Engineering Lab, Environmental Engineering & Water Testing Lab, Surveying Lab with Total Stations, Concrete & Highway Materials Lab, Computer Aided Design (CAD) Lab, Department Library.
CIVIL.achievements: VTU Research Centre, Minor QIP Centre, active ASCE Student Chapter, SustaiNest Environmental Club, high consultancy revenue from government and private civil projects.
CIVIL.labs_and_facilities: Structural Engineering Lab, Geotechnical Engineering Lab, Environmental Engineering & Water Testing Lab, Surveying Lab with Total Stations, Concrete & Highway Materials Lab, Computer Aided Design (CAD) Lab, Department Library.

MECH.about: The Department of Mechanical Engineering (NBA Accredited) made its beginning with the establishment of the college in 1960. It offers a 4-year (8 semesters) autonomous B.E. course with an intake of 120 students. The department has well-experienced and dedicated faculty members with many active researchers: totally 28 faculty with an average teaching experience of 17 years, of which 18 hold Ph.D.s and the remaining hold M.Tech./M.Sc. qualifications. All laboratories are well-equipped with state-of-the-art machinery like CNC machines, Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM), 3D Printer, 6-axis articulated Robot, Computerised UTM, and Surface Profilometer. Recognized as a VTU Research Centre, the department has received substantial grants from DST, AICTE, VGST, VTU, UGC, and TEQIP.
MECH.vision: To emerge as department of high repute in Mechanical Engineering and allied fields through effective teaching-learning process and research activities, operating with a sense of professional and social responsibility.
MECH.mission:
1. Empower students to scale high in their professional career through upskilling.
2. Effective association with higher institutes of learning, industry and research laboratories with emphasis on multi-disciplinary approach.
3. Encourage students to participate in sustainable projects.
4. Inculcate professional and ethical norms in all activities.
MECH.programs_offered:
- B.E. in Mechanical Engineering (Intake: 120)
- Ph.D. and M.Sc. (Engg) by Research under VTU
MECH.labs_facilities: Robotics & Automation Lab (6-axis articulated Robot), CNC Simulation & Machining Centre, Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM) Lab, Additive Manufacturing (3D Printing) Lab, Computerised UTM & Materials Testing Lab, Thermal & Fluid Mechanics Labs.
MECH.achievements: NBA Accredited, VTU Research Centre with extensive external grants (DST, AICTE, VGST, TEQIP), numerous peer-reviewed international publications and patents.
MECH.labs_and_facilities: Robotics & Automation Lab (6-axis articulated Robot), CNC Simulation & Machining Centre, Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM) Lab, Additive Manufacturing (3D Printing) Lab, Computerised UTM & Materials Testing Lab, Thermal & Fluid Mechanics Labs.

EEE.about: The Department of Electrical & Electronics Engineering (E&EE), earlier known as Electrical Power Engineering, is one of the first three branches of engineering started at MCE in 1960. The faculty includes 3 Ph.D. holders specialized in various fields and nine more in advanced stages of pursuing Ph.D. Over 200 research papers have been published by the faculty in international journals and conferences. In addition to the B.E. program, the department offers an M.Tech. Degree in Power and Energy Systems (PES). Recognized as a VTU Research Center with 11 external research scholars, 4 Ph.D. and 4 M.Sc. degrees have been awarded. The department has received total research funding of about Rs. 1.80 Crores from Government funding agencies, maintaining excellent laboratories and a computer center.
EEE.vision: To become a department of excellence in the domain of Electrical and Electronics Engineering producing competent engineers with research acumen having moral and social values.
EEE.mission:
1. Enhance industry and alumni interaction.
2. Promote continuous quality up gradation of faculty and technical staff.
3. Time to time modernization of departmental infrastructure to provide state of the art laboratories.
4. Create research-oriented culture to invoke the desire and ability of lifelong learning among students for pursuing successful career.
5. Create and sustain environment of learning in which students acquire knowledge and learn to apply it professionally with due consideration of social and ethical values.
EEE.programs_offered:
- B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering (Intake: 60)
- M.Tech. in Power and Energy Systems (PES) (Intake: 18)
- Ph.D. and M.Sc. (Engg) by Research under VTU
EEE.labs_facilities: Power Systems Simulation Lab, Electrical Machines Laboratory, Power Electronics & Drives Lab, Control Systems Lab, Microcontroller and Embedded Systems Lab, Department Computer Center.
EEE.achievements: Over Rs. 1.80 Crores in government research grants, 200+ research papers published, recognized VTU Research Center with 8+ completed doctorate and master degrees.
EEE.labs_and_facilities: Power Systems Simulation Lab, Electrical Machines Laboratory, Power Electronics & Drives Lab, Control Systems Lab, Microcontroller and Embedded Systems Lab, Department Computer Center.

ECE.about: The B.E. degree course in Electronics & Communication Engineering was instituted in 1967, and an independent department of E&C Engineering was established in 1981. The autonomous 4-year B.E. course has an intake of 90 students (affiliated to VTU). The department also offers an M.Tech degree in Digital Electronics & Communication Systems (DECS, instituted 1987) with an intake of 25 students. Recognized as a VTU research center for M.Sc (Engg) & Ph.D. since 1990, the department possesses top-tier laboratories enhanced through TEQIP-I grants and Ministry of Human Resources Development (MHRD)/AICTE Direct Central Assistance schemes. The department maintains MOUs with INSAT Master Control Facility (ISRO Hassan), Eagle Photonics Bangalore, and BSNL.
ECE.vision: To produce industry ready, research oriented and socially responsible Electronics and Communication Engineers.
ECE.mission:
1. To create an ambience for learning.
2. To conduct research, beneficial to the society.
3. To promote industry-academic interaction at all levels.
4. To be continuously agile to the needs of the stake holders.
ECE.programs_offered:
- B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering (Intake: 90)
- M.Tech. in Digital Electronics & Communication Systems (DECS) (Intake: 25)
- Ph.D. and M.Sc. (Engg) by Research under VTU
ECE.labs_facilities: VLSI Design Lab, DSP & Image Processing Lab, Advanced Communication & Microwave Lab, Microprocessor & Embedded Systems Lab, Optical Fiber Communication Lab, TEQIP-funded Advanced Electronics Lab.
ECE.achievements: Strategic MOUs with ISRO Master Control Facility (MCF Hassan), BSNL, and Eagle Photonics; excellent placement record; recognized VTU research center since 1990.
ECE.labs_and_facilities: VLSI Design Lab, DSP & Image Processing Lab, Advanced Communication & Microwave Lab, Microprocessor & Embedded Systems Lab, Optical Fiber Communication Lab, TEQIP-funded Advanced Electronics Lab.

EIE.about: The Department of Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering (formerly known as Instrumentation Technology) came into existence in 1984 as an offshoot of E&CE. The department was accredited by NBA under Tier-1 during 2017-2020 and 2020-2023. Renamed to Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering in 2014 by VTU, the department attained autonomous status in 2007-08 and offers a B.E. degree with an intake of 60 plus 10% lateral entry. Facilities include Process Control, Digital ICs, Analog ICs, Microcontroller, DSP, and VHDL labs, along with an in-house library of 1,200+ volumes. The department has won a university gold medal hat-trick, earned AICTE MODROBS grants (Rs. 6.00 Lakhs), and conducts government ICT Phase-II inspection programs.
EIE.vision: The department will be a Centre of excellence for Electronics and Instrumentation studies driven by research, in association with industry and society.
EIE.mission:
1. To augment infrastructure in emerging technologies.
2. To provide student centered environment for effective learning by giving hands-on experience.
3. To develop research culture and create facilities for transforming idea into products to cater to society and industrial needs.
4. To collaborate with industry, academia and research organizations for contribution to the higher order learning and research.
5. To prepare students to meet the challenges of dynamic industrial requirements and higher education.
EIE.programs_offered: - B.E. in Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering (Intake: 60)
EIE.labs_facilities: Process Control Lab, Industrial Instrumentation Lab, Digital ICs and Analog Circuits Lab, Microprocessor and DSP Lab, VHDL Lab, Department Library (1200+ volumes).
EIE.achievements: Tier-1 NBA Accreditation (2017-2023), University Gold Medal Hat-trick, AICTE MODROBS funding (Rs. 6.0 Lakhs), VTU sponsored research project (Rs. 5.0 Lakhs).
EIE.labs_and_facilities: Process Control Lab, Industrial Instrumentation Lab, Digital ICs and Analog Circuits Lab, Microprocessor and DSP Lab, VHDL Lab, Department Library (1200+ volumes).

VLSI.about: The Department of Electronics Engineering (VLSI Design & Technology) was established at Malnad College of Engineering in the academic year 2025-26 with an intake of 60 students to develop skilled professionals for the rapidly evolving global semiconductor and chip design industry. The program nurtures future-ready engineers with strong foundations in VLSI systems, semiconductor technology, embedded electronics, and intelligent hardware design. The department offers practical exposure through advanced laboratories, modern EDA tools, FPGA and ASIC design platforms, semiconductor fabrication concepts, and RTL design. Students are prepared for high-demand careers as VLSI Design Engineers, Verification Engineers, FPGA Engineers, and Semiconductor Engineers.
VLSI.vision: To build a dynamic center of excellence in VLSI and Semiconductor Technology education that empowers students to become innovative chip designers, technology leaders, and entrepreneurs driving advancements in semiconductor and intelligent electronic systems.
VLSI.mission:
1. To provide high-quality education in VLSI Design and Semiconductor Technology through a strong foundation in electronics engineering, modern laboratories, and industry-oriented learning.
2. To nurture innovation, creativity, and research skills by promoting project-based learning, internships, technical workshops, and collaboration with industry and research organizations.
3. To develop skilled and ethical professionals capable of designing advanced semiconductor and intelligent electronic systems for emerging global technologies.
VLSI.programs_offered: - B.E. in Electronics Engineering (VLSI Design & Technology) (Intake: 60)
VLSI.labs_facilities: Advanced EDA Tools Laboratory, ASIC and FPGA Synthesis Lab, Semiconductor Device Simulation Lab, Embedded Hardware Design Lab.
VLSI.achievements: Strategic establishment to support the India Semiconductor Mission, cutting-edge EDA tool partnerships, direct career pathways into semiconductor and fabless chip design industries.
VLSI.labs_and_facilities: Advanced EDA Tools Laboratory, ASIC and FPGA Synthesis Lab, Semiconductor Device Simulation Lab, Embedded Hardware Design Lab.

MCA.about: The Department of Computer Applications was established in 1988 and served as a strong academic unit for over three decades, successfully producing skilled IT graduates until 2019. From the academic year 2025–26, the Department of Computer Applications has been restarted with renewed focus, an updated industry-aligned curriculum, modern computing infrastructure, and active project-based learning. Dedicated faculty members guide students in application development, cloud computing, database administration, web technologies, and software engineering. Alumni are placed in reputed IT firms globally.
MCA.vision: To be a premier department to produce competent professionals to develop sustainable computer based applications for the industrial and societal needs.
MCA.mission:
1. Facilitate effective learning environment by providing industry focused technical education.
2. Make students to acquire the necessary skills to continue independent learning and research.
3. To inculcate professional ethics driven by social concerns.
MCA.labs_facilities: Dedicated MCA Computer Laboratory, Full-Stack Web Development and Database Lab, Software Testing Lab, Department Library.
MCA.achievements: Three-decade legacy in computer applications education, comprehensive 2025-26 curriculum modernization, strong corporate placements in application development.
MCA.labs_and_facilities: Dedicated MCA Computer Laboratory, Full-Stack Web Development and Database Lab, Software Testing Lab, Department Library.

FIRST_YEAR.about: The First-Year Department (Basic Sciences) plays a foundational role in shaping students' understanding of core scientific principles essential for engineering studies. Covering Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology for Engineers, and Communicative English, this department provides students with the analytical skills and theoretical knowledge necessary for tackling complex engineering challenges. Courses strengthen problem-solving abilities and build a solid scientific mindset, bridging the transition from high school to specialized engineering disciplines with well-equipped modern laboratories.
FIRST_YEAR.vision: To be an institute of excellence in engineering education and research, producing socially responsible professionals.
FIRST_YEAR.mission:
1. Create conducive environment for learning and research.
2. Establish industry and academia collaborations.
3. Ensure professional and ethical values in all institutional endeavours.
FIRST_YEAR.programs_offered: - Foundational Engineering Curriculum for all First-Year B.E. Programs
FIRST_YEAR.labs_facilities: Physics Laboratory, Chemistry Laboratory, Computer Programming Laboratory, Language Lab for Professional Communication.
FIRST_YEAR.achievements: Extensive academic bridge courses, student mentorship programs, highly rated faculty with doctorate qualifications across sciences and humanities.
FIRST_YEAR.labs_and_facilities: Physics Laboratory, Chemistry Laboratory, Computer Programming Laboratory, Language Lab for Professional Communication.

MATH.intake: Supports all UG and PG Engineering Programs
MATH.about: Establishment of the Department of Mathematics took place in 1960 with the founding of the college. Since 1960, the department continues to impart mathematical rigor, modeling, and analytical thinking to all engineering graduates of this institution. The department focuses equally on teaching and research. The department is equipped with 15 dedicated faculty members, including 4 Ph.D. holders, with 8 faculty members actively pursuing doctoral research in applied mathematics, differential equations, fluid mechanics, graph theory, and computational methods.
MATH.vision: To be good research center in the field of applied mathematics.
MATH.mission:
1. Update faculty members with advances in mathematics of physics and allied subjects.
2. Introduce computer based tools and techniques for modeling and solving mathematical connected physics problems.
3. To be a master degree awarding department in applied mathematics.
4. To depute faculties to premier institutes so as to pursue research in the field of applied mathematics.
MATH.programs_offered: - Advanced Engineering Mathematics, Discrete Mathematical Structures, Linear Algebra, Probability & Numerical Methods across all B.E. and M.Tech. programs
MATH.labs_facilities: Computational Mathematics & Simulation Lab, Department Library, Research Center in Applied Mathematics.
MATH.achievements: Recognized research contributions in applied mathematics and fluid mechanics, continuous research publications in reputed scientific journals.
MATH.labs_and_facilities: Computational Mathematics & Simulation Lab, Department Library, Research Center in Applied Mathematics.

PHY.about: The Department of Physics is a recognized Research Centre under Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), Belagavi, conducting intense research in Quantum dots, Nanotechnology, Solar cells, Materials Science (Magnetic Materials, Magneto-caloric Materials, and Ceramics). Equipped with highly qualified teaching and research faculty, the department maintains fully-fledged laboratories and advanced experimental setups. The curriculum exposes students to fundamental physics concepts underlying modern advanced engineering technologies.
PHY.vision: To impart quality education in the process of understanding fundamentals based on which present or future technology is established, exposing students to new and important basic concepts in physics to solve complex engineering problems.
PHY.mission:
1. The department is with a proposal of starting a master degree in Physics in the near future timeline.
2. Upgradation of advanced experimental facilities to conduct frontline research for invention and innovation.
PHY.programs_offered:
- Engineering Physics for UG B.E. Programs
- Ph.D. and M.Sc. (Engg) by Research under VTU
PHY.labs_facilities: Engineering Physics Laboratory, Nanotechnology & Materials Science Research Laboratory, Advanced Optics & Solar Cell Setups.
PHY.achievements: Recognized VTU Research Centre, active research projects in Nanotechnology and Magnetic Materials, numerous high-impact journal publications.
PHY.labs_and_facilities: Engineering Physics Laboratory, Nanotechnology & Materials Science Research Laboratory, Advanced Optics & Solar Cell Setups.

CHEM.about: The Department of Chemistry teaches and promotes practical aspects of chemistry to build a solid foundation as part of engineering education. The faculty members are deeply committed to teaching and frontline research, having published more than 30 research papers of high repute in national and international journals. Key research areas include chemical kinetics, corrosion inhibition studies, water analysis, soil testing, and organic synthesis. The department also provides consultancy services in water analysis and soil quality testing.
CHEM.vision: To establish infrastructure and provide a conducive environment for quality education.
CHEM.mission:
1. To modernize research laboratories to take up innovative projects.
2. To encourage faculty to acquire Ph.D. degrees and motivate them to make research an integral part of professional duties.
3. To supervise engineering student projects and provide required internet accessibility for skill enhancement.
4. Construction of smart classrooms and undertaking consultancy in water and soil testing.
5. Proposals to start B.E. in Chemical Engineering and PG courses in Industrial Chemistry.
CHEM.programs_offered:
- Engineering Chemistry for First-Year B.E. Programs
- Doctoral Research in Applied Chemistry under VTU
CHEM.labs_facilities: Engineering Chemistry Laboratory, Instrumental Analysis Lab, Water Quality and Soil Testing Consultancy Facility, Department Research Lab.
CHEM.achievements: Over 30 peer-reviewed research papers, active environmental testing and water consultancy for Hassan district, recognized doctoral research center.
CHEM.labs_and_facilities: Engineering Chemistry Laboratory, Instrumental Analysis Lab, Water Quality and Soil Testing Consultancy Facility, Department Research Lab.

RAI.about: The Department of Robotics and Artificial Intelligence offers an autonomous B.E. program designed to produce engineers at the intersection of mechanical design, electronics, sensor systems, computer vision, and machine intelligence. Students acquire competencies in industrial manipulator robotics, autonomous mobile robots, embedded AI controllers, ROS (Robot Operating System), and intelligent automation for manufacturing and healthcare applications.
RAI.vision: To emerge as a premier destination for education and innovation in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence, creating forward-thinking engineers who develop autonomous and intelligent physical systems for societal advancement.
RAI.mission:
1. Deliver rigorous interdisciplinary education combining robotics mechanics, electronics, and artificial intelligence.
2. Provide cutting-edge laboratory facilities with industrial robotic arms, mobile robot platforms, and simulation software.
3. Foster hands-on project work, innovation, and industry collaborations in intelligent automation and robotics.
4. Cultivate ethical engineering standards and social awareness in autonomous systems design.
RAI.programs_offered: - B.E. in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence (Intake: 60)
RAI.labs_facilities: Robotics Simulation and Hardware Lab, 6-Axis Robotic Manipulator Setup, Autonomous Mobile Robots Lab, Sensor and Actuator Interfacing Lab.
RAI.achievements: Active robotics design challenges, high corporate placement interest in robotics automation, industrial robotics competitions.
RAI.labs_and_facilities: Robotics Simulation and Hardware Lab, 6-Axis Robotic Manipulator Setup, Autonomous Mobile Robots Lab, Sensor and Actuator Interfacing Lab.

CADS.about: The M.Tech. program in Computer Aided Design of Structures (CADS) is a specialized postgraduate program offered under the Department of Civil Engineering. With an annual intake of 18 students, the program provides advanced technical education in structural dynamics, finite element analysis, earthquake-resistant design, advanced concrete and steel design, and computational structural modeling. Graduates are recruited as senior structural consultants and design engineers.
CADS.vision: To achieve national recognition in structural engineering education and computational structural design, producing highly competent structural specialists.
CADS.mission:
1. Impart advanced computational design and structural modeling expertise using industry-standard finite element software.
2. Conduct field-relevant research in seismic design, high-performance concrete, and structural optimization.
3. Collaborate with structural consulting firms and infrastructure development authorities for practical student training.
CADS.programs_offered: - M.Tech. in Computer Aided Design of Structures (CADS) (Intake: 18)
CADS.labs_facilities: Advanced CAD & Structural Modeling Lab (ETABS, STAAD.Pro, ANSYS), Structural Testing Lab, Computational Mechanics Lab.
CADS.achievements: 100% placement and consultancy absorption of structural engineering postgraduates, major contributions to state infrastructure consulting.
CADS.labs_and_facilities: Advanced CAD & Structural Modeling Lab (ETABS, STAAD.Pro, ANSYS), Structural Testing Lab, Computational Mechanics Lab.

DECS.about: The M.Tech. program in Digital Electronics and Communication Systems (DECS) was instituted in 1987 under the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering. With an annual intake of 25 students, the program offers specialized training in advanced digital signal processing, modern wireless communications, digital IC design, embedded communication hardware, and RF system design. The department has produced outstanding university academic ranks and alumni in leading telecom and semiconductor firms.
DECS.vision: To produce specialized communication and digital electronics engineers capable of leading technological innovation in wireless communications and digital hardware systems.
DECS.mission:
1. Impart rigorous knowledge of contemporary wireless protocols, digital electronics design, and signal processing.
2. Provide hands-on access to advanced communication testbeds, DSP processor kits, and RF simulation suites.
3. Promote research collaborations with organizations like ISRO and telecommunications enterprises.
DECS.programs_offered: - M.Tech. in Digital Electronics & Communication Systems (DECS) (Intake: 25)
DECS.labs_facilities: DSP & Digital Communication Lab, Advanced RF & Microwave Lab, VLSI Architecture & Communication Testbed Lab.
DECS.achievements: Over three decades of postgraduate excellence since 1987, consistent university rank holders, joint research with ISRO MCF Hassan.
DECS.labs_and_facilities: DSP & Digital Communication Lab, Advanced RF & Microwave Lab, VLSI Architecture & Communication Testbed Lab.

PES.about: The M.Tech. program in Power and Energy Systems (PES) is offered under the Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering with an annual intake of 18 students. The curriculum covers modern power system dynamics, smart grid technologies, renewable energy integration (solar and wind), power electronics for electric vehicles, and energy storage systems. Students engage in sponsored research funded by government and industrial energy organizations.
PES.vision: To lead in power systems education, smart grid engineering, and renewable energy research, producing innovative power engineering leaders.
PES.mission:
1. Deliver specialized education in smart grid architectures, renewable power systems, and electric transportation technologies.
2. Facilitate cutting-edge simulation and experimental facilities in modern power systems and power quality analysis.
3. Engage in collaborative research on national energy challenges, energy efficiency, and decentralized generation.
PES.programs_offered: - M.Tech. in Power and Energy Systems (PES) (Intake: 18)
PES.labs_facilities: Power Systems Simulation Lab (MiPower, MATLAB/Simulink), Renewable Energy and Microgrid Lab, Smart Power Electronics Lab.
PES.achievements: Extensive research projects funded by government agencies, alumni placed in power utilities, renewable energy firms, and central research centers.
PES.labs_and_facilities: Power Systems Simulation Lab (MiPower, MATLAB/Simulink), Renewable Energy and Microgrid Lab, Smart Power Electronics Lab.

AIDS.about: The M.Tech. program in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science was introduced in 2023 with an annual intake of 18 students. Offered jointly with modern computing infrastructure, the program focuses on advanced machine learning algorithms, big data architectures, natural language understanding, computer vision, data warehousing, and AI system design. It prepares postgraduates for advanced research and industry careers as Lead Data Scientists and AI Research Engineers.
AIDS.vision: To be a leading center for advanced study and research in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, fostering innovators who develop ethical and intelligent solutions for complex data problems.
AIDS.mission:
1. Provide in-depth academic and practical education in advanced machine learning, deep neural architectures, and big data engineering.
2. Establish state-of-the-art computational infrastructure with GPU servers and cloud data analytics platforms.
3. Promote applied research, industry internships, and ethical data governance standards.
AIDS.programs_offered: - M.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science (Intake: 18)
AIDS.labs_facilities: AI & Big Data Computing Lab, GPU Deep Learning Server, Cloud Analytics Lab.
AIDS.achievements: Rapidly growing postgraduate program with strong industry alignment and high-demand data engineering placements.
AIDS.labs_and_facilities: AI & Big Data Computing Lab, GPU Deep Learning Server, Cloud Analytics Lab.

MBA.about: Malnad College of Engineering (MCE), Hassan does not offer a Master of Business Administration (MBA) programme. The institution offers Undergraduate (B.E.) programmes across 9 engineering disciplines and Postgraduate programmes including Master of Computer Applications (MCA) and M.Tech in specialized disciplines.
MBA.vision: To provide high quality education in technical and professional fields.
MBA.mission: Deliver excellent education and research opportunities in engineering and technology disciplines.
MBA.programs_offered: MCE Hassan offers B.E. (Civil, Mechanical, EEE, ECE, EIE, CSE, ISE, AIML, CSBS), MCA, and M.Tech programmes. MBA is not offered.
